name: Red Hat Hardened Images
summary: Free, vendor-neutral catalog of distroless, micro-sized container images, scanned for security and tested.
description: A catalog of trusted, micro-sized container images built with a reduced attack surface and security moved to the start of the build process. The images ship with validated security profiles and an integrated SBOM, get CVE remediation with scanning and testing, and run on any Linux container platform, cloud or bare metal.
contains: CVE remediation with scanning and testing
